title: Chapter 1405
text:
Just as he was about to say something, Han Xiao suddenly realized that there was an additional set of coordinates in his mind. It was a mental message from Tyrsius.

Han Xiao looked at Tyrsius in confusion.

"What coordinates did you give me?"

Tyrsius shook his head, sighed softly, and slowly said, "That's right.

"My hometown is my remaining obsession. Although I was born on Planet Cree, I left a long time ago. When I was young, I surpassed all my predecessors, broke all records, and became the strongest person in the entire civilization. However, my civilization could no longer provide me with any help. In order to pursue a higher level of individual strength, I traveled into the galaxy alone for countless years.

In my hometown, no one is my match. I'm trying to find someone with the same level as me in the entire universe. I want to learn by analogy and exchange experiences. In my wandering life in the universe, I spent most of my time in the desolate starry sky. I rarely met people, but I also saw strong and weak civilizations. Only when I met powerful Supers would I appear. At other times, I would not interfere with the normal development of these civilizations. At that time, I only had the path ahead in my eyes. I wanted to become stronger and stronger. Until the day I died, I did not return to my hometown even once.

I have been dead for countless years and have been trapped here. I have no perception of the outside world and have long accepted reality. However, the only thing I can't let go of is my hometown. I have nothing to do here. The only thing I can comfort myself with is the incomplete memories of the past. It is just that my firm pursuit of a higher level and the miraculous experiences of wandering the universe have faded, and my life in my hometown when I was a child has become more and more profound.

Back then, I could have chosen to stay and help build my hometown, but I was unwilling to do so. I wandered for a higher pursuit, but now, I miss my hometown more and more. So many years have passed, and I don't know how my hometown is doing now. You inherited my Beyonder's Vestige. If it's convenient for you, I request that you go over and help me take a look. The coordinates I gave you are the location of Planet Cree. I hope you can help me take care of them on my account. "

After hearing his explanation, Han Xiao could not help but raise his eyebrows with a strange expression.

"Don't you know that it's best not to come into contact with unfamiliar civilizations? You don't know my background, yet you gave me the coordinates of your hometown. Aren't you afraid that I'll bring people to invade?"

Tyrsius smiled faintly.

"You're the only one who came in after so many years. I'm about to die, so who else can I give it to but you? If it's risky, then it's risky. There's no such thing as a sure thing in this world. Otherwise, I wouldn't have risked my life to try and break through to a higher level, which ultimately led to my death … Also, I don't think you're an invader. "

"Coming to a conclusion after only seeing me once is too hasty." Han Xiao shook his head and said, "I can help you take a look, but I won't promise you anything. Besides, I don't think a powerful universal civilization needs my help."

"You misunderstood. My civilization is not particularly developed."

Tyrsius sighed.

"You were able to withstand the impact of the Universe's assimilation. I can sense your strength. On the other hand, I believe you also feel that I'm very powerful. But in fact, when I left my hometown, I was far from this powerful. Back then, it was very difficult for me to destroy a planet. My strength was obtained through constant breakthroughs while I was wandering … The experience I accumulated should have been brought back to my hometown to give birth to more powerhouses. Unfortunately, I died, and these plans were foiled."

Hearing this, Han Xiaoxin quickly calculated.

From the sounds of it, when Tyrsius first started wandering, his strength should have been between a high-level Calamity Grade and an ordinary Beyond Grade A. The latter was more likely. During his long and lonely journey, he rose to the peak of the Beyond Grade A realm step by step and felt the existence of a higher level. He had reached this step without any experience or reference, which was equivalent to the pioneer of the path.

From the looks of it, Tyrsius is also a talented person, probably not inferior to me … cough, not inferior to all the genius Supers in the history of the three Universal Civilizations.

If what the other party said was true, then the other party's civilization should be like a remote village, not as strong as he had imagined. It was just that they had produced a genius, just like how the Blue Star had produced him.

If Tyrsius returned to his hometown with his experience and comprehension, there might be another civilization with developed individual strength in the universe.

Thinking about it this way, the Supers who were born in the three Universal Civilizations were lucky. There were many strong people here, and there were many opponents to spar with. For a small civilization like Tyrsius, if he wanted to pursue his opponent, he could only go far away and be a lonely Dao Seeker.

Just as he was thinking, the interface suddenly rang.

You have triggered the mission [Shadow of the Past]!

Mission Introduction: In order to explore the path ahead, Tyrsius wandered the universe alone and never returned to his hometown. He hopes that you will go and take a look.

Mission Requirements: Reach Planet Cree.

Reward: 200 billion EXP, 1 Character Summon Card.

"A mission …"

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat.

He did not know if Tyrsius was so open-minded and sincere because of his nature, or because he felt relieved and wanted to settle his affairs, or because he had special feelings for his successor.

At this moment, Tyrsius' figure was getting fainter and fainter, almost disappearing. He did not mind and only smiled.

"Looks like my time is almost up. After so many years of loneliness, I'm satisfied to have someone to talk to at the end of my journey …"

Han Xiao looked at him silently and muttered to himself. Although it was an accident, the first and last time they met. Originally, Tyrsius' wandering knowledge was a precious channel to understand more about the unknown civilization, but there was no time.

However, at this moment, Tyrsius seemed to have thought of something and said softly,

"By the way, let me give you a piece of advice. If one day, you encounter a civilization called the World Tree, it's best to run as far away as possible …"

Han Xiao was stunned, and his expression changed slightly.

However, before he could ask for more details, Tyrsius' figure completely disappeared, leaving behind only a faint sigh.

"I didn't leave anything for the civilization in my life. What a failure …"

As soon as he said that, the blue figure in front of Han Xiao turned into light particles and disappeared.

At the same time, the mental load that was getting weaker and weaker finally stopped.

The white alternate space in front of him suddenly collapsed. Han Xiao was in a daze and realized that his vision had returned to the main material universe. He was still where he was and had not moved at all.

This Beyonder's Vestige had already merged into his body and was entrenched alone, but it did not have any further reaction with him.

Although he had obtained the Beyonder's Vestige, Han Xiao was not very excited.

"You're only halfway through your sentence. You should have said it earlier if you encountered the World Tree …"

Han Xiao was helpless, but since he was gone, he could only complain.

After all, Tyrsius did not know that they were at war with the World Tree Civilization. If the other party had not taken the initiative to mention it, he would not have known that Tyrsius had encountered the World Tree Civilization.

"It sounds like this guy has seen the aggressiveness of the World Tree before. Maybe they've interacted before. Maybe the World Tree still remembers this guy?"

Han Xiao pondered.

Very soon, he shook his head and put this matter aside for the time being. He turned around and studied the Beyonder's Vestige in his body. This was his main goal.

After absorbing the Beyonder's Vestige, his strength did not change at all. He could only sense its existence at any time, as if he was using his body as a container to store it.

This Beyonder's Vestige should only be activated during the Promotion and become a catalyst for the Promotion. He roughly guessed that regardless of whether the Promotion succeeded or not, this Beyonder's Vestige would be consumed. This was a one-time use item.

"The higher stairs require the bones of the predecessors … Tsk, turning into firewood, burning yourself to benefit the future generations. No matter what, I owe you a favor."

Han Xiao exhaled.

Although the other party was dead, he still remembered this favor. The next time he revived in the Sanctum, he planned to try to revive this guy. However, the chances were very low.

Transforming into the Beyonder's Vestige, he did not know if he had intercepted the Information Form like the two sisters of the previous generation. Even if he was completely dead now, he might not be able to revive in the Sanctum. Han Xiao only planned to do his best and leave it to fate.

At this moment, Han Xiao suddenly thought of something and smiled.

"Speaking of which, in the explored universe, only this Beyonder's Vestige is the easiest to obtain. If Wuornos reaches this stage one day, he can only sail far away to find other Beyonder's Vestige."

Han Xiao was amused.

Wuornos was so willing to help him advance. Perhaps he wanted him to explore the way, but he did not know that the only Promotion material nearby would be missed.

Perhaps Wuornos did not have a notification from the interface, so he could not dig out the Beyonder's Vestige, or perhaps he did not enter the critical state and was stuck on the mission. In any case, he was guarding a treasure mountain without knowing, and in the end, he was the first to reach it.

Feeling the Beyonder's Vestige quietly waiting in his body, Han Xiao smiled. Although there were some unexpected circumstances, he still obtained a Beyonder's Vestige in the end. It was smoother than he had expected. It was not in vain that he had gathered so many mascots in the army.

This way, the three Promotion requirements were only left with the simplest one, which was to find four handsome guys to help.

Han Xiao finally relaxed. He then muttered the coordinates of Planet Cree that Tyrsius had sent him and fell into deep thought.

"There will definitely be risks in rashly coming into contact with an unfamiliar civilization. Although Tyrsius said that his civilization is not strong, that's all old news. Now that so many years have passed, it might have become a powerful Universal Civilization. Furthermore, I can't rule out the possibility that Tyrsius is cheating …"

After thinking for a while, Han Xiao still felt that he had to take a look. With the King, he could come and go as he pleased. Furthermore, he planned to send out his Lord's Avatar like a Mechanic and not take the risk himself.

On one hand, he wanted to complete the mission and see what would happen next. On the other hand, he felt that Tyrsius' civilization might be a potential ally and could be pulled over to fight the World Tree together. After all, the World Tree's style and mechanism could be said to be the public enemy of most intelligent civilizations.

…

Two days later, in the Ancient Star Desert, a certain Radiant Federation military base.

A Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device was slowly warming up, and a Lord's Avatar was waiting in the teleportation area. Han Xiao watched from afar from the base outside, followed by a respectful base officer.

Han Xiao's Face Fruit had already reached Greater Mastery, so there was basically no possibility of being rejected when he borrowed the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device from the Radiant Federation.

Seeing the two giant mechanical rings of the teleportation device spin rapidly and turn into a halo, Han Xiao could not help but sigh.

"Your Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device is really a convenient invention. As long as you have the coordinates, you can go anywhere in the universe."

"Indeed. This is the highest technological achievement of our Radiant Federation." The base officer straightened his back and was a little proud.

"Amazing, amazing. Can you let me bring it back for research?"

"This … Please don't make things difficult for me." The base officer was stunned and smiled bitterly.

Han Xiao smiled faintly and stopped teasing this officer. He activated his Lord's Avatar.

At this moment, the power of the teleportation device reached its peak. Suddenly, there was a flash of light, and the Lord's Avatar disappeared without a trace.

Han Xiao's vision turned, and he arrived at the outer space of a planet. In front of him was a dark green giant planet.

There were many satellites floating in orbit outside the planet. There did not seem to be any problems on the surface, but with a glance, Han Xiao could tell that these satellites had not been maintained for many years. They had all been scrapped and turned into scrap metal. Vegetation covered the entire surface of the planet. With a cursory glance, he could not see any traces of a civilized city. There were also no life signals. It gave off a desolate feeling of decline.

Only a brown metal tower was eye-catching. Looking down from outer space, it was like this planet was wearing a small pointy hat. After converting the proportions, one could tell that this metal tower was extremely huge, reaching straight into the clouds.

Its appearance was very rough, like countless metal objects of different shapes piled up together. The structure of the building was loose, like a huge mountain of trash.

"This is Planet Cree? It seems like something has happened … "

Han Xiao was thinking when his pupils suddenly shrank. He quickly adjusted his vision to long-range mode, and his vision quickly enlarged. He locked onto a small black dot that was slowly moving halfway up the metal tower.

It was a robot with mottled rust all over its body. It was carrying a metal fragment that was several times its size. It was slowly climbing along a steep path toward the top of the metal tower. In Han Xiao's field of vision, this was the only thing that could move.

Han Xiao's eyes moved slightly. He controlled the Lord's Avatar to descend and land in front of the robot, revealing himself.

However, this robot acted as if it did not see him and walked straight past him. When it brushed past him, Han Xiao could even hear the other party repeating the same word non-stop.

"Bury it … Bury it …"
